data.name: Pari
data.gender_notes: Pari is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Persian parī, 'fairy, a beautiful supernatural being'. Its root is Persian parī. A Persian and Urdu name widely used in India. Pari is a Persian name meaning “Fairy; angel; beauty”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pari expresses “Fairy; angel; beauty”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Persian parī, 'fairy, a beautiful supernatural being'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pari total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
